The global economic conditions remain weakened.
At the same time, uncertainty about the activity outlook in the largest economies persists.

The Council assesses that incoming data indicate low demand and cost pressures in the Polish economy, which amidst weakened economic conditions and falling inflation pressure abroad will support a gradual decline in domestic inflation.
Considering the adjustment in the NBP interest rates introduced in recent months, together with inflation, the Council decided to keep the NBP interest rates unchanged.
The Council judges that the current level of the NBP interest rates is conducive to meeting the NBP inflation target in the medium term.
The Council upheld the assessment that the decrease in inflation would be faster if supported by an appreciation of the zloty exchange rate, prospects for inflation and economic activity.
NBP will continue to take all necessary actions in order to ensure macroeconomic and financial stability, including above all to bring inflation down to the NBP inflation target
